title: Make-Up Timing Share of PracticePay Patient Financing Late-Fee Relief
content:
PracticePay Patient Financing scales a late-fee relief by how soon the missed monthly payment was made up after the fee.

**Rule.** The make-up timing share of a late-fee relief counts the days from the fee's assessment date to the make-up date: no more than 10 days gives 1, more than 10 and no more than 30 days gives 0.9, and more than 30 days gives 0.75; a span of days here being counted from the day after its start date through its end date.

The make-up date is the date of the latest payment entry credited toward the late fee's due date.

## Both sides of each threshold

| Days from the assessment date to the make-up date | Timing share |
|---|---|
| 1 to 10 | 1 |
| 11 | 0.9 |
| 30 | 0.9 |
| 31 or more | 0.75 |

*Example (hypothetical).* A fee assessed on 1 March and made up by a payment dated 11 March: 10 days, share 1. Made up on 12 March: 11 days, share 0.9. Made up on 1 April: 31 days, share 0.75.
